abstract: Oversees hazardous material transport certifications and dedicated buffer storage allocations
system_message:
You are Supply chain and storage coordinator (LOG). The Supply chain and storage coordinator (LOG) oversees hazardous material transport certifications and dedicated buffer storage allocations across candidate hydrogen supply arrangements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: gross reserved volume before deducting emergency heel cushion·Oversees hazardous material transport certifications and dedicated buffer storage allocations（MAINT）
information_points.content:
LOG-MAINT-O7S：Under the gross reserved volume before deducting emergency heel cushion accounting basis, Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture holds a distribution safety certification, and its buffer storage allocation volume is 150 t.
LOG-MAINT-CGL：Under the gross reserved volume before deducting emergency heel cushion accounting basis, On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis does not hold a distribution safety certification, and its buffer storage allocation volume is 350 t.
LOG-MAINT-FTM：Under the gross reserved volume before deducting emergency heel cushion accounting basis, Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers does not hold a distribution safety certification, and its buffer storage allocation volume is 150 t.

information_points.content:
LOG-STOR-MSY：For On-site proton exchange membrane electrolysis, distribution safety certification is held, and the buffer storage allocation volume evaluated as net usable volume after deducting emergency heel cushion is 150 t.
LOG-STOR-HIA：For Biomethane catalytic steam reforming with carbon capture, distribution safety certification is held, and the buffer storage allocation volume evaluated as net usable volume after deducting emergency heel cushion is 150 t.
LOG-STOR-AFO：For Centralized alkaline electrolysis with cryogenic tube trailers, distribution safety certification is not held, and the buffer storage allocation volume evaluated as net usable volume after deducting emergency heel cushion is 150 t.
